title: 实验2：核验周期解与CCM失效

setup.raw:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.linalg import expm
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp
setup.value:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.linalg import expm
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp

cells.raw:
L, C, Vin, D, fs = 1e-3, 100e-6, 24.0, .5, 20000.0
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3))
for R in [6.0, 30.0, 120.0]:
    A = np.array([[0, -1/L], [1/C, -1/(R*C)]])
    b = np.array([Vin/L, 0.0])
    ton, toff = D/fs, (1-D)/fs
    Eon, Eoff = expm(A*ton), expm(A*toff)
    q = np.linalg.solve(A, (Eon-np.eye(2))@b)
    x0 = np.linalg.solve(np.eye(2)-Eoff@Eon, Eoff@q)
    times = np.linspace(0, 1/fs, 1001)
    values = np.array([expm(A*t)@x0 + np.linalg.solve(A, (expm(A*t)-np.eye(2))@b) if t <= ton else expm(A*(t-ton))@(Eon@x0+q) for t in times])
    nodes, weights = np.polynomial.legendre.leggauss(16)
    integral = np.zeros(2)
    for node, weight in zip(nodes, weights):
        t = (node+1)*ton/2
        integral += weight*ton/2*(expm(A*t)@x0 + np.linalg.solve(A, (expm(A*t)-np.eye(2))@b))
        t = (node+1)*toff/2
        integral += weight*toff/2*(expm(A*t)@(Eon@x0+q))
    print("period mean i, v:", *(integral*fs))
    minimum = values[:, 0].min()
    print("R, Imin, di_pp, dv_pp:", R, minimum, np.ptp(values[:, 0]), np.ptp(values[:, 1]))
    if minimum > 0:
        ax.plot(times*1e6, values[:, 0], label=f"R={R:g} ohm")
    else:
        print("INVALID: CCM continuation crosses zero; not a diode Buck solution")
ax.set(xlabel="time (us)", ylabel="inductor current (A)", xlim=(0, 50), ylim=(0, 2.3))
ax.grid(True); ax.legend(); plt.show()

title: 实验3：局部连续PI与答案复算

setup.raw:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.linalg import expm
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp
setup.value:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.linalg import expm
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp

cells.raw:
L, C, R, Vin, Kp, Ki = 1e-3, 100e-6, 6.0, 24.0, .02, 20.0
# Perturbations about i=2A, v=12V, duty=.5; reference step +.1V.
M = np.array([[0, -(1+Vin*Kp)/L, Vin/L], [1/C, -1/(R*C), 0], [0, -Ki, 0]])
g = np.array([Vin*Kp/L, 0, Ki])*.1
times = np.linspace(0, .05, 1001)
sol = solve_ivp(lambda t,z: M@z+g, [0, .05], np.zeros(3), t_eval=times, rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-12, method="DOP853")
assert sol.success
voltage = 12+sol.y[1]
duty = .5+Kp*(.1-sol.y[1])+sol.y[2]
print("Ki strict upper bound:", (1+Vin*Kp)/(R*C*Vin))
print("poles:", np.linalg.eigvals(M))
print("v(20ms), v(50ms):", voltage[400], voltage[-1])
print("duty min/max:", duty.min(), duty.max())
assert duty.min() > 0 and duty.max() < 1
assert abs(voltage[-1]-12.1) < 1e-6
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3))
ax.plot(times*1000, voltage); ax.axhline(12.1, color="gray", ls="--")
ax.set(xlabel="time (ms)", ylabel="voltage (V)", xlim=(0, 50), ylim=(11.98, 12.14))
ax.grid(True); plt.show()
